$comment: The tour of a finished run (/c/<colony>?tour=1, on its replay). Keys: → or PageDown next, ← or PageUp back, space play or pause, Home first step, End last step. Each step stands on a moment found in the colony's own events (replay.ts findMoment): at is a moment or a list tried in order (@rule, @first-claim, @first-landing, @first-proof, @first-stale, @first-notice, @first-return, @calm, @hot, @busiest, @batch, @converged, @last-landing, @start, @end); every moment but @rule counts only events after the rule was declared. A step whose moments the record lacks is left out, and steps follow the run: by their moment, ties in this order. kicker and caption are text, or an object keyed by moment name ("*" for any). Other fields, as in director/script.json: offset (seconds after the moment), duration (seconds the step holds when the tour plays), tab (events, intents, review, why), select ("path" or "path:line", used when the run landed on that path; @moment; @last-landing), highlight (@moment, @needs), focus (@moment, @selected; absent shows the whole map), emphasize (hero, stats, sigma, vaccine, funnel, trunk; text or keyed by moment), estimated (the numbers rest on claim times, estimated in a reconstructed record), commands (shell lines under the sentence, with {server}, {repo}, {colony} and {selArg} filled in). Captions are filled once, at the moment: {when} {rules} {violations} {needFiles} {agentsAtWork} {file} {files} {settledBy} {returnPath} {reason} {noticeAgents} {inFlight} {hotFile} {hotReturns} {hotLandings} {hotAgents} {batchSize} {fixed} {fixedIn} {intentsLanded} {landingsSince} {proofLine} {selWhere} {colony}.

steps.caption: A person declared {rules} that found {violations} violations in {needFiles}: each became a need in the field, and no one assigns the work.
{agentsAtWork} {when}, each on an intent it chose from the field, and each claim keeps the other agents off its files.

caption.@first-proof: The first change settled by a deterministic proof landed {when}, in {file}: no model was consulted.
caption.@first-landing: The first change landed {when}, in {file}, settled by {settledBy}.

caption.@first-stale: The first change came back {when}, because {returnPath} had changed on trunk after its agent read it: it goes back to be redone rather than land stale.
caption.@first-notice: A landing changed {files} {when}, and the colony told {noticeAgents} still working on it what changed, before their changes could go stale.
caption.@first-return: The first change came back {when}, with this reason: “{reason}”.
caption.@calm: At the busiest moment, {when}, {inFlight} in flight at once, and in the whole run not one change came back to its agent.

caption.@hot: {hotFile} was the hottest file: {hotReturns} named it, and {hotAgents} worked on intents that cover it.
caption.@busiest: {hotFile} changed most often: {hotLandings} landed on it, from {hotAgents}.
caption.@batch: A lane landed {batchSize} non-conflicting changes in one commit {when}: {files}.

steps.caption: {fixed} violations fixed in {fixedIn}: {intentsLanded} landed in {landingsSince} after the rule, and {proofLine}.
{selWhere} remembers why it changed: its intent, agent, model and checks ride with the commit as a git note, which any git clone can read.
commands: # The same lineage from the command line, no token needed
# Clone a colony with stock git and read its newest note
# Check that note against its commit's FT-Note digest: prints intact
